headline: Pattachitra and the names a painting carries

image.creator: Sumit Surai
image.alt: An artist’s hand uses a fine brush on a Pattachitra with figures and patterned borders.
image.caption: An artist working on a Pattachitra in Raghurajpur, photographed in 2013. The source does not name the artist.
image.changes: Resized and converted to WebP. No generated elements; derivative retains the stated share-alike licence.
image.inspection: Existing local image visually inspected on 5 October 2026; hand, fine brush, figures and patterned borders support the opening. File hash matches prior provenance record. No claim that every depicted figure or the unnamed artist is identified.

section_sources.evidence: Reused image and its existing credit record; visually inspected. Creative invitation, not an eyewitness encounter.

section_sources.limit: Described traditional practice does not certify materials or methods of every work.

section_sources.section: A picture that has a voice
section_sources.limit: Specific regional accounts; no claim that all Bengal forms are alike or all Odisha work lacks performance.
Recognition of both regions by March 2008; not earliest existence or priority.
Dates are certificate milestones; no exclusive historical origin finding.

section_sources.evidence: Original editorial guidance and conditional example, not a documented misattribution incident.
